title: Harbor and Tide
author: Beatrix Sandoval
blurb: Noor Amberdale, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
